description: Land Reform Commission - Amend the Order made on the portion of land called Nalandawatta, Matale D/S Division, Matale District published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 181/12 of 27.02.1982 and alienate again to the Land Reform Commission
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily concerned with land matters, specifically the revocation and re-alienation of a portion of land called "Nalanda Waththa" between the Land Reform Commission and the Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation. It contains detailed land descriptions, survey plans, and legal procedures under the Land Reform Act. While a Minister is named, this is incidental to the core land transaction content, which fits squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land acquisitions, transfers, and property matters.
